name: Maximum-voltage measuring relay
summary: Measuring relay that operates when the monitored voltage rises above its set level.
description: The maximum-voltage relay form operates when voltage exceeds its setting. Typical uses include generator overvoltage after load rejection, capacitor bank protection and inverter connection points, where sustained high voltage can stress insulation or breach grid connection limits.

The box shows a greater-than voltage threshold but not whether the element uses phase-to-phase or phase-to-neutral quantities, the reset ratio or the time delay. Grid-connection settings are usually specified as several stages with different delays, which this single symbol does not reveal.
readingNotes: Identify the voltage connection used by the element.
Check for multiple stages in the settings record.
distinction: A maximum-voltage relay responds to high voltage magnitude; a residual voltage relay responds to neutral displacement.
